definitions.psd_area: Standard per-class PSDS1 curve area, full split and negatives retained; no single-threshold tuning.
definitions.oracle_negative_clip_gate: GT-known negative clips set to -1e6; full durations retained. Diagnostic only, not deployable or an additive error attribution.
definitions.matchability: For each merged GT event independently, does ANY threshold component satisfy one-to-one DTC>=.7 and GTC>=.7? Different events may choose different thresholds; other false positives ignored. Not event recall and not a formal PSDS upper bound.
definitions.grid_matchable: Same one-to-one criterion allowing ANY interval on the native frame grid, ignoring learned scores.
definitions.local_auc: Duration-weighted native-bin score AUC for event vs 1s context on both sides, excluding other same-class GT from negatives. Fractional GT overlap weights; not the earlier 100ms-grid AUC.
definitions.peak_position: Strict max in any GT-overlapping frame vs max in frames with zero GT overlap; tied plateaus kept separate.
definitions.scope: Observational cross-model comparisons. Raw-vs-scores is a controlled postprocessing intervention on saved outputs. No training, no test-set configuration selection.
definitions.bootstrap: Paired source-recording cluster bootstrap; source key is clip.rsplit("_",2)[0]. Event-weighted post-minus-raw difference, 3000 draws, seed 20261019, percentile 95% interval. Exploratory, no multiplicity correction.
